location_qualifier: Bois de Feuillet; point = Forêt de Gouffern area
current_activity: 84th Division assembles in the Bois de Feuillet to follow the LXXXIV Corps across the Dives
notes: Event date: Breakout and Pursuit ch. 27 p. 540 and p. 550-551: on 19 August the 84th and 363d Divisions of the LXXIV Corps moved into the Bois de Feuillet, west of the Dives, to assemble and be ready to cross the Dives in the wake of the LXXXIV Corps. Location: the Bois de Feuillet, which the source pairs with the Gouffern forest; it is not in the place list. Location approximate: the point is the Forêt de Gouffern area, precision 10 km.
